_help: Windows-only: see winxmerge-compare.windows.json for why there's no Linux/macOS version bundled alongside this one. Mark 2 files for a 2-way compare or 3 files for a 3-way merge (base, left, right in list order), then pick this from the context menu. Replace <WINXMERGE_PATH> with wherever your own copy of the tool lives. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
name: Compare in WinXMerge
